patent.title: 基于指纹识别的终端及其待机状态下的登录方法、系统
assignees: 深圳市汇顶科技股份有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E4-N1. Single-patent Shenzhen intermediate judgment (2018)粤03民初3258号. Do not inherit Goodix portfolio revenue.

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout; Goodix listed assignee; inventorship genealogy not reconstructed.

technology.problem: 待机状态下如何用指纹识别安全唤醒并登录终端。
technology.mechanism: 指纹扫描识别→唤醒主控并发送确认→解锁/登录流程（授权权利要求；诉讼主张 claim 1、5）。

value_carriers.name: 思立微被控指纹芯片产品（裁判认定侵权）
value_carriers.description: Court found accused Silimicro fingerprint-chip products infringe ZL201410204545.4 claims 1 and 5; Dingxin sold some units. Carrier is adjudicated infringer product-line, not Goodix own branded module.

value_metrics.metric_name: court-awarded patent infringement damages (incl. costs components in judgment_amount)
value_metrics.note: Dispute-specific E4. Silimicro ¥40M economic loss + ¥19871.66 costs; Dingxin ¥50k. Discretionary on infringer fingerprint-chip profit narrative. Not intrinsic patent price.

gaps.description: Damages rest on discretionary infringer-profit apportionment (fingerprint-chip line share / multi-year narrative), not audited lost profits of Goodix own product.
needed_evidence: Full audit trail of profit base
Rightsholder product-level lost sales tied to this ZL

gaps.description: No field-normalized technical-quality benchmark beyond infringement finding.

notes: Holdout E4-N1. T0=2026-10-13. Single-ZL court E3+E4+E5 → R5. Judgment≠auto R5 without E3/exact_patent metric—those are present. Still dispute-specific; not V0.8; not intrinsic price.
